model: CARTIER Tank Must Extra-Large Automatic WSTA0053 (41 x 31 mm steel, silver dial, steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Cartier Tank Must template (Santos and other Cartier variants copy this approach): two brancards (rounded vertical bars of the case, outer edge from the photo silhouette), brushed case bars above and below the dial opening, a recessed dial plane carrying the 2x photo map (numerals, railroad track, date window and the photographed hands stay in it), a flat crystal, blue sword hands over the photographed ones, a faceted steel crown with a blue sapphire cabochon (steel_photo projected, so the blue comes from the photo) and a three-column brushed steel bracelet at the photo's own joints. Everything is projected from the front photo; heights are estimated (no side view).

case.note: brancards: slabs from the silhouette's outer edge to the inner edge, the top and bottom corners follow the silhouette rows; bars: rectangles between the brancards (case.bar_*_y_mm of the trace); core: flat block under the dial

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, about 0.05 mm wider than the photographed hands so the 3D hands hide the ones in the map; the last point sits at the traced length. Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front, so the blue comes from it)

crown.note: lathe profile [radius, x] mm along the 3 o'clock axis: faceted steel part (widest 3.1 mm at x 16.8) then the sapphire cabochon dome; studs and the blue come from the projected photo

bracelet.note: three brushed columns (outer / centre / outer) in pieces at the photo's joints (trace.bracelet); piece rows and the vertical joint lines are measured in the measure JSON

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
